newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly firmer in the after-hours session on Tuesday, lifted by scattered technical buying, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.7 yen higher than the day's close. Benchmark April was flat at 141.1 yen.
Volume was thin with only 4,525 lots traded.

During the day, prices edged lower on seeing the yen's fall against the dollar had stalled. "The market is looking for clear direction. Prices are likely to move within narrow ranges unless there are fresh factors," one trader said.
